Strategy: Pair equal items. Leaving one item-sized space keeps a bin productive for a same-size arrival, while an exact fit wastes nothing, so both rank top. Score bins by distance from a post-placement leftover of item, with exact fits tied at the top, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a bin that preserves pairing room. It may help by grouping equal items and keeping bins reusable, but may fail by passing up tight fills and leaving many bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(abs(r - item - item)) + (item if r - item == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```
